name: Christmas AI
tagline: Make Christmas photos, printable cards, pet portraits, ugly sweater pics, and personalized Santa videos from your browser. Try free with 10
description: Christmas AI is a browser-based holiday studio with eight tools: AI Christmas Photo Generator, Personalized Santa Video, Santa Caught on Camera, Add Santa to Photo, AI Christmas Card Generator, AI Pet Christmas Photo, Add Santa Hat to Photo, and Ugly Christmas Sweater Generator. Upload everyday photos, pick a style, and download images or MP4s without an app. New accounts receive 10 free credits; one-time pay-as-you-go credit packs are available with no subscription.
